title: Strict convexity and differentiability of the exponential planar passage shape
exact_target: For nearest-neighbor first-passage percolation on $Z^2$ with independent mean-one exponential edge weights, is the asymptotic unit ball strictly convex with a continuously differentiable boundary? Equivalently ask for differentiability of the time constant at every nonzero direction and no line segment in its unit sphere.
